info.name: Couchbase Analytics Service REST Allowed CIDRs Search Queries API

params.name: indexName
params.description: The name of the Full Text Search index

items.docs: Executes a full-text search query against the specified index. Supports various query types including match, term, phrase, boolean, numeric range, date range, geospatial, and conjunction/disjunction queries. Results include relevance scores, highlighting, and faceted results.
